scoreboard_action_semantics.q017_cash: Show research attention rankings but canonical action remains NO BUY/CASH_BLOCKED.
scoreboard_action_semantics.e2_off: E2 candidate may appear for attention but cannot create an entry.
scoreboard_action_semantics.v43_watchlist_only: V43 daily Top3 may contribute watch points but native buy rule activates only when the frozen H20 schedule selects the signal.
scoreboard_action_semantics.w1_gate: W1 cannot independently become entry-ready unless the registered 40bp total-cost expected-value gate is positive as required.
scoreboard_action_semantics.missing_current_x_or_q1: Score zero for current-stock scoreboard; do not rerun frozen/eliminated research merely to manufacture picks.
scoreboard_action_semantics.hold_and_exit: Use only the native active lane's own horizon and exit semantics. Time-based exits do not receive fabricated price targets.

source_of_truth: repository contracts and current valid artifacts, not conversation memory

authority.purpose: persistent cumulative scan orchestration with one-glance total scoreboard
